title: Complete Étude Op. 25 No. 5 preview prepared for review
summary: A complete preview of Chopin’s Étude Op. 25 No. 5 with Krystian Zimermonkey is prepared for review, combining a score-derived piano soundtrack, a gradual note visualizer and four camera views including an overhead view. Opening titles and visual fades are included; hand and motion refinements await feedback, and the performance remains in development.

title: Clair de lune published on Instagram and YouTube Shorts
summary: Special guest Claude Degoosey performs a 1:48 selected passage from Claude Debussy’s Clair de lune, now published as an Instagram Reel and YouTube Short. The portrait performance includes a synchronized note visualizer, four camera views including an overhead keyboard view, opening titles and visual fades.

title: Clair de lune full-passage render and camera integration milestone
summary: Claude Degoosey's complete selected Clair de lune passage now has a continuous performance render with four camera views, including an overhead keyboard view. Refinements to seated movement, elbow position and interactions between the hands are continuing; the performance remains a work in progress.

title: Clair de lune relaxed hand-pose studies prepared
summary: New Claude Degoosey hand-and-palm studies show more relaxed held-chord positions, alongside short normal-speed previews with the project's piano soundtrack. Transitions and the complete selected performance remain in development.

title: Clair de lune shoulder and hand-motion previews prepared
summary: New Claude Degoosey previews show closed, rounded shoulder connections and an updated chord-to-bass transition with the project’s piano soundtrack. Hand movement and the selected performance remain in development. The earlier Nocturne draft has been set aside.

title: Nocturne phrasing and note-release revision prepared
summary: Updated phrase timing, voice balance and varied note lengths are reflected in a new selected-passage Nocturne draft and portrait export. Musical phrasing and movement remain under review.

title: Clair de lune soundtrack and movement studies underway
summary: A piano soundtrack has been prepared for a selected passage from Debussy’s Clair de lune, with Claude Degoosey as the pianist. Finger movements and transitions remain in development; a complete performance video remains unfinished.

title: Complete selected Nocturne draft and portrait exports prepared
summary: The complete 1:41 selected passage from Chopin’s Nocturne in C minor, Op. 48 No. 1 is prepared in landscape and portrait formats, with synchronized note views and the natural ending retained. Listening and movement remain under review.

title: Nocturne Op. 48 No. 1 draft combines animation and piano
summary: A 20-second draft of the selected passage from Chopin’s Nocturne in C minor, Op. 48 No. 1 now pairs the rendered pianist’s movement with the chosen piano soundtrack. Motion refinements continue; the complete selected-passage performance and its portrait version remain unfinished.

title: Shared keyboard aligns holds and evaluated fingertips
summary: Planned key holds, evaluated positions for all ten fingertips, and held-contact targets now share one keyboard layout with common physical key bounds, spacing, and orientation. Distinct key fills and point markers keep planned holds and evaluated geometry separate.

title: Winter Wind showcase combines playback and ten-finger diagnostics
summary: The approved website brings Winter Wind playback, timing, pedal, finger assignments and evaluated positions for all ten fingertips into one full-performance showcase. Shared playback controls connect the top video, the viewing formats and the combined diagnostic while moving through the page.

title: Nocturne Op. 48 No. 1 selected-passage production underway
summary: Work has resumed on a selected passage from Chopin’s Nocturne in C minor, Op. 48 No. 1, using the project’s rendered pianist and stage. A short motion-and-sound pilot has been produced. The complete selected-passage performance and its portrait version remain unfinished.

title: Winter Wind published on YouTube and Instagram
summary: The 3:25 Winter Wind performance is published on YouTube and Instagram. The full Instagram version uses the revised portrait layout with a larger keyboard. A short Instagram excerpt is also published.

title: Winter Wind motion refinements and 3:25 review exports
summary: At this review milestone, targeted hand and body refinements and a clearer note visualizer were integrated into Winter Wind. The 3:25 landscape and full portrait review exports included a four-second ending fade. Playback, phone presentation and the sound choice were still under review before the later release.

title: Full Winter Wind performance rendered for review
summary: The complete 3:31 Winter Wind performance was rendered at 60 fps, including a closing bow. This dated review milestone preceded later changes to the motion, portrait layout and ending.

title: Furnished recital-room and pianist-motion preview
summary: A twelve-second rendered preview introduced the furnished recital room, hand closeups and refined leaning motion. Hand shapes, contact and movement were still being developed at this stage.

title: Full performance scene integrated
summary: The complete Winter Wind timeline was assembled in rendering software with phrase-timed cameras, gaze, pedal motion and a seated bow. Movement and key contact were still being refined before release.

title: First integrated rendered motion preview
summary: A ten-second software-rendered preview brought torso, arm, wrist and finger movement together. It recorded an early stage of the animation work.

title: Project walkthrough completed
summary: The 88-second demonstration presented the music-and-animation pipeline, matched revisions and recorded release outcomes. Its review screens were labelled demonstration reconstructions.
